note: Laouenan et al. (2022), A cross-verified database of notable people, 3500BC-2018AD, Scientific Data 9:290; data.sciencespo doi:10.21410/7E4/RDAG3O. Notable people (Wikipedia/Wikidata) counted at their birthplace in 0.5° cells; one frame per era of birth, labelled by the era's first year (astronomical: -499 = 500 BC), and 'all'. Log scale, clamped to 1–3,000 people per cell; 0 = none. 1,654,727 of 2,291,817 people have both a birth year and a birthplace.
